sources.note: Describes British Sign Language (BSL), not Providencia Sign Language; 'Providence' occurs only in a reference (Brown University Press, Providence, Rhode Island) and 'prosodic' only in the title of Brentari 1999 in the reference list. Attempt 1 at the listed ScienceDirect PDF URL could not be reached by automated download bot page; attempt 2 downloaded the same CC BY 3.0 article from Europe PMC (PMC2278232). Read: abstract, introduction, materials and methods, discussion; full-text search for stress/accent/prosod/suprasegment/tone/Providen/Colombia.

sources.citation: Omardeen, Rehana. 2022 [online 2023]. Providence Island Sign Language in Interaction. PhD dissertation, Georg-August-Universität Göttingen. 236 pp. DOI 10.53846/goediss-10243, hdl 11858/15035.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. No phonology or prosody chapter (chapters: introduction; sampling signers; initial person reference; other-initiated repair; discussion). Ch.2 §2.2 'Linguistic Research' (pp.40-42) reviews all prior PISL work as sociolinguistic plus basic lexical elicitation; full-text search for stress/prosod/accent/phonolog/suprasegment finds only incidental mentions of a 'prosodic pause' separating alternatives in repair sequences.
